verdict.rationale: Supabase's own connection guide says it provides several ways to connect to its Postgres database from frontend, persistent-backend and serverless code, which is the basis for ORM and framework use. The evidence never names Prisma, Drizzle, Django or Rails, and contains no per-ORM or per-framework guides, so 'out of the box' compatibility with documented guides is only thinly supported. missing for 10: named ORM/framework guides (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails), evidence of out-of-the-box compatibility details such as pooler or connection-string guidance per ORM, independent or hands-on corroboration of ORM usage

support.subject: As a developer, the database works out of the box with my ORM and framework (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails) with documented guides

citations.quote: Supabase provides several ways to connect to your Postgres database, whether your code runs in the frontend, in a persistent backend, or in a serverless function.
